## Duplicate check

- [ ] I have searched the existing issues and did not find a duplicate feature request.

## Problem or use case

What problem should this feature solve?

Example: Admins currently cannot delete users or uploaded flights from the web interface.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or behavior you would like to see.

Example: Add an admin page where authorized admins can delete users and flights.

## Feature area

Which part of SimSoar is affected?

- [ ] Authentication / User Management
- [ ] Flight Upload
- [ ] Flight Analysis
- [ ] Flight Details
- [ ] Leaderboards / Rankings
- [ ] Admin Area
- [ ] UI / UX
- [ ] Dark Mode / Appearance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Deployment / Operations
- [ ] Other

## Suggested priority

How important is this feature from your perspective?

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High
- [ ] Critical

## Acceptance criteria

What must be true for this feature to be considered complete?

- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...
- [ ] ...

Example:

- [ ] Admins can see a list of users.
- [ ] Admins can delete a selected user after confirmation.
- [ ] Admin actions are logged.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you considered.

## Mockups, screenshots, or references

Upload mockups, screenshots, or references if helpful.

## Additional context

Add anything else that may help us evaluate this request.
